answer: An hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 28 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The gale counter is kept in cedar and ripple exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 28 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The per-identity price is 103 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
